note: PLACEHOLDER until the pipeline and the routing engine deliver real files (flat ground, no slope, no ridges; the grid search stands in for the routing engine)
crs: +proj=eqc +lat_ts=0 +lon_0=0 +R=3396190 +units=m (Mars 2000 sphere, as the USGS Gale DEM)
origin_is: north-west corner of cell (row 0, col 0), projected metres
order: row 0 = north, columns west to east, index = row * nx + col

dtype.ttb: float32 little-endian, minutes to the habitat, +Infinity where unreachable
dtype.ptr: int32 little-endian, index of the next cell towards the habitat, -1 at the habitat and where unreachable
